# crosswork_l2vpn_y1731_profiles (Data Source)

This data source can read a Y.1731 profile of the L2VPN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l2vpn_y1731_profiles" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-y1731"
  name = "cwtest-y1731"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the profile. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_archive` (Number) Number of buckets kept
- `bucket_size` (Number) Number of measurements in a bucket
- `delay_statistics` (Attributes Set) Delay statistics, only for the type `delay` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--delay_statistics))
- `loss_statistics` (Attributes Set) Loss statistics, for the types `loss` and `synthetic-loss` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--loss_statistics))
- `probe_frame_size` (Number) Size of the frame in bytes.
- `probe_measurement_interval` (String) Seconds of a measurement, 1 to 3600, or `once` (only with the probe type `packet`)
- `probe_message_count` (Number) Messages of a burst. Message count times message period divided by 1000 must not exceed the measurement interval.
- `probe_message_period` (Number) Milliseconds between the messages of a burst
- `probe_priority` (Number) Priority of the frames
- `probe_type` (String) Kind of probe, `burst` when left out. With `packet` NSO drops the message count and the message period without an error.
- `schedule_duration` (String) Minutes that the operations last, 1 to 1440, or `forever`
- `schedule_interval` (Number) Minutes between the operations. It has to be a factor of 1440 (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30, 32, 36, 40, 45, 48, 60, 80 or 90).
- `type` (String) Kind of measurement. `delay_statistics` belong to `delay`, `loss_statistics` to `loss` and `synthetic-loss`.
